title: Exactness of inverse image
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $u^{-1}:\Ab(V_{\Et})\to\Ab(U_{\Et})$ be the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] between the categories of abelian sheaves on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Then $u^{-1}$ is an exact functor: it commutes with finite limits and with finite colimits (Stacks Project, Categories, Definition 0034); in particular it is additive, preserves kernels and cokernels, and carries short exact sequences $0\to G'\to G\to G''\to0$ of abelian sheaves on $V_{\Et}$ to short exact sequences on $U_{\Et}$.

proof.text: Specialize the existing source-library instance AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.preservesFiniteLimits_upperStar to AddCommGrpCat and f. Its Kan-extension hypothesis is discharged by AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.preservesFiniteLimits_op_lan_overPullback_of_isGrothendieckAbelian. Thus the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] preserves finite limits. This source proof already composes inclusion, the left-exact presheaf Kan extension and sheafification, so no separate statement modules are needed.

The adjunction upperStarLowerStarAdjunction supplied with [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] gives preservation of colimits and hence finite colimits. The existing instance additive_upperStar gives additivity on abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Both conclusions are obtained by instance synthesis.

For every morphism of abelian sheaves, instance synthesis specializes finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation to its parallel pair with zero, giving kernel and cokernel preservation. For every short exact complex S, apply Mathlib ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact to its short-exactness proof and upperStar: finite-limit preservation gives preservation of monomorphisms and kernels, finite-colimit preservation gives preservation of epimorphisms and cokernels, and additivity gives preservation of zero morphisms.

proof_origin.place: Instances preservesFiniteLimits_upperStar and additive_upperStar, upperStarLowerStarAdjunction; Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/ShortComplex/ShortExact.lean, ShortExact.map_of_exact. These implement Stacks 03Q1(1) through the original Kan-extension and sheafification argument.

split_report.summary: Statement kept in substance and made explicit: 'morphism' now cites def-pc-scheme (a Mathlib leaf for schemes and their morphisms) instead of the grab-bag def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, the categories cite def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, and 'exact' is spelled out (finite limits and finite colimits, Stacks 0034). The imported one-step proof argued that the presheaf inverse image has a left and a right adjoint, which was not justified (a presheaf pullback u_p has no left adjoint in general, and none was constructed here) and cited 03Q1 as if it were a sheafification lemma; replaced by a five-step proof following Stacks 03Q1(1): u^{-1} = # o b_p o iota (Stacks 03Q0 formula, 00WX), right exactness from the reviewed lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-preserves-colimits, left exactness from the base-change functor commuting with finite limits (new leaf lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits, Stacks 021D/021I), the presheaf pullback along such a functor commuting with finite limits (new leaf lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-pullback-left-exact, Stacks 00X3/00X5/00YT) and sheafification being exact with limits of sheaves sectionwise (new leaf lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact, Stacks 00WJ/03CO). def-weil-pbc-etale-site and def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves dropped from proof_deps (replaced by the precise nodes). Not a Mathlib leaf: Mathlib lacks continuity of MorphismProperty.Over.pullback for smallEtaleTopology, and its Lan finite-limit lemma needs small categories.

lean.statement: theorem upperStar_abelian_exact {U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ V) : PreservesFiniteLimits (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f) ∧ (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).Additive ∧ (∀ (G H : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (φ : G ⟶ H), PreservesLimit (parallelPair φ 0) (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f) ∧ PreservesColimit (parallelPair φ 0) (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f)) ∧ (∀ (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})), S.ShortExact → (S.map (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f)).ShortExact)
